refuted.description: true if a credible independent contradiction was found, OR the claim has no support outside its original source and looks doubtful; false if it stands up.

reason.description: One or two sentences: what the independent search found and why it does or does not refute the claim.

counterSourceUrl.description: URL of an independent source that contradicts the claim, if one was found.

independentConfirmationUrl.description: URL of an independent source (different site/author/org from the original) that confirms the claim, if one was found.
